**Key observations:**
- Sugarcane plant with one prominent leaf showing intense **yellow coloration specifically along the midrib** (central vein)
- Surrounding leaf lamina remains green
- Some dried/brown leaves visible in background (progressive necrosis)
- Purple/reddish stem coloration visible
- No mosaic/mottled patterns (rules out Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus and Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv)
- No white pencil line (rules out Leaf_Scald)
- No white streaks across the lamina

The hallmark symptom here is **yellowing concentrated along the midrib**, which is the defining feature of Yellow_Leaf disease.
